capabilities: Download remote images and other attachments into a vault folder
Render the cached local file instead of the remote URL
Whitelist or blacklist vault paths and remote URLs for caching
Rewrite note links to local files via an archive option
Expose a global API for third-party plugins
disambiguation: Not an attachment manager or mover; it only caches remote-URL attachments locally so they render without the remote.
extras: The README states the plugin is not under active development, though bugs and issues get priority. Documentation is said to be available via the settings help, not the README. Includes a troubleshooting section about caching images rendered asynchronously by other plugins, with priority-based wait times.
problem: Remote images in notes break when offline or when the remote host disappears, and must be re-fetched on every render.
summary: Local cache for remote attachments: downloads remote images and media into the vault and renders them from the local copy.
